Hero.headline: DANIEL ARIAS:
Hero.sub: Redefining the cello through the lens of modern vanguardism and symphonic legacy.

Artist.label: 01 // THE BIOGRAPHY
Artist.heading: ENGINEERING SOUND
Artist.body1: From the rigorous training grounds of El Sistema to the world's most prestigious concert halls, Daniel Arias has forged a path of technical stamina and uncompromising artistic vision. His approach to the cello is one of structural exposure—a raw, physical engagement with the instrument.
Artist.body2: Specializing in the demanding repertoire of the 20th and 21st centuries, Arias is celebrated for his interpretations of Shostakovich, Lutosławski, and Xenakis. His performances are marked by a precision that rejects the decorative in favor of the essential.
